description: Official profile of a French association (loi 1901) by RNA number from the Répertoire national des associations (Ministry of the Interior, monthly export): title, purpose and Waldec purpose codes, nature and grouping, position (active/dissolved/deleted), creation, declaration, JO publication and dissolution dates, registered office, website, RUP number as declared, prefecture, and the SIREN when Sirene confirms an association. Covers associations WITHOUT a SIREN; use search_french_associations first when you only have a name. No officer or declarant data; Alsace-Moselle excluded (local law). Unknown identifier = 404, not charged. Paid via x402 ($0.005 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

rna.description: RNA number (W + 9 characters, e.g. W751004076) or legacy RNA identifier as published (3-14 characters)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_association_profile

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French association profile (RNA)
